Looking for a job with a great salary, awesome colleagues, and zero boring moments? Look no further! Grab your tools, and come to work as an assembly line worker by DKG in Bergen op Zoom. And yes, you read that right: you’ll be earning a sweet €17,24 per hour (including shift allowances)! 💸

What we offer
- A nice salary of €17,24 gross per hour.
- Shift allowances. You get 15% in 2 shifts!
- Get a permanent contract quickly!
- Travel allowance starting from 5 km
- Career opportunities! Become a driver or operator!
- A nice bonus family at the workplace!

Who you are
To keep the production running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as an assembly line worker:

- You speak Dutch or English;
- You are available for 3 to 5 days;
- You are available for at least 2 shifts;
- You are able to do physical harder work;
- You can work in Bergen op Zoom;
- You have your own transport to get to the DKG factory;

What will you do
Boom! The buzzer sounds and the line starts moving. You are ready to roll! As our new Assembly Line Worker, you are the ultimate puzzle master. Together with an awesome team, you keep the production running like clockwork.
Armed with your trusty tools, you click, screw, and assemble parts into a perfect end product. Spot a scratch or a missing screw? Sharp as a hawk, you catch it instantly. Quality is your middle name! You keep your workspace spinning and your supplies stocked. Hit a daily target? High-fives all around! With high energy and a great playlist, your day flies by before you know it. 🚀

Where will you work
When people ask you what you do for work, you can say: "I'm in the kitchen all day." 🤩 At DKG de Keukenfabriek in Bergen op Zoom you work in a modern logistics warehouse. Full of kitchen parts and materials! Together with your colleagues you make sure every order leaves on time.

You'll join a friendly team with a great work atmosphere. And the best part? There are lots of growth opportunities! Grow further to a

The largest data centers in the Netherlands are in the Eemshaven. You keep the power they rely on running.
As an Electrical Engineer Data Center you work on the critical electrical installations in the Eemshaven: UPS systems, standby generators, distribution boards and the measurement and control equipment that goes with them. You carry out preventive maintenance, inspect installations, take measurements, resolve faults and record every action, because in these buildings the documentation weighs as much as the work. You are there when the manufacturer commissions new systems, so you see up close how a site is built up. If you come from commercial and industrial buildings and UPS is new to you, you learn those systems here on the installation itself. The work asks for precision and reliability: in these buildings the power must never fail.
The essentials: Salary €3.300 to €4.100 per month · 38 hours per week · Fulltime · Based in Groningen.
In this role you earn €3.300 at entry, rising to €4.100 as an experienced engineer. Growing on to Senior can later reach €4.900, but you are applying now for the Data Center Engineer role.
What you bring
- MBO 3 or 4 Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
- Solid experience as an electrical engineer in commercial and industrial buildings, for example offices, healthcare, industry or data centers
- Knowledge of UPS systems, distribution boards, backup power and instrumentation, extensive experience with them is a strong plus
- NEN 3140 VP and VCA, or the willingness to obtain them
- Driver's license B; Dutch and English at working level

What we offer
- Work in the largest and most secure data centers in the Netherlands
- Training and certification on UPS systems from Eaton and Schneider Electric
- NEN 3140, VCA, LOTO and ESD training
- The opportunity to obtain NEN 3840 (high voltage)
- Metal & Engineering CAO with travel allowance, overtime pay and ADV days
- A clear growth path to Senior Data Center Engineer
